description:
Gandhinagar Full-time 2-4 Years

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are searching for a skilled and experienced DevOps Engineer to join our growing team. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between development and operations, ensuring a smooth and efficient software delivery lifecycle. You will be responsible for automating processes, building and maintaining infrastructure, and collaborating with developers to deploy code changes seamlessly.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Proven experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, etc.).
* Solid understanding of infrastructure as code (IaC) principles.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Experience with configuration management tools (Chef, Puppet, Ansible).
* Strong scripting skills (Bash, Python, etc.).
* Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) (must).
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Problem-solving and analytical skills.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate software delivery processes.
* Utilize infrastructure as code (IaC) tools like Terraform or Ansible to provision and manage infrastructure.
* Configure and manage cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Implement and maintain configuration management tools (Chef, Puppet, Ansible).
* Automate infrastructure deployments and configurations.
* Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues.
* Collaborate with developers and operations teams to ensure smooth deployments.
* Stay up-to-date on the latest DevOps tools and technologies.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* **Certifications:** Relevant certifications from AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes Administrator, or similar.
* **Agile Methodologies:** Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* **Networking:** Understanding of networking concepts and technologies.
* **Database Management:** Experience with database management and optimization.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** DevOps Engineer  
**Location:** Gandhinagar, Gujarat (Work from office)  
**Experience:** 4–7 years

**DevOps Engineer**

We are looking for an experienced **DevOps Engineer** with around **4-7 years of hands-on expertise in Azure/AWS Cloud** to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building, maintaining, and improving our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation to support high-availability, scalable systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and optimize **Azure/AWS cloud infrastructure** using services like Azure VM, AKS, App Service, Storage, VNet, Key Vault, Monitor, and Azure DevOps.
* Build and maintain **CI/CD pipelines** for microservices and web applications using Azure DevOps, GitLab/GitHub Actions, or Jenkins.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning using **Terraform or ARM/Bicep templates**.
* Implement configuration management and deployment strategies using **Ansible**, **Docker**, and **Kubernetes (AKS)**.
* Monitor system performance and ensure **high availability**, **scalability**, and **cost optimization** across cloud workloads.
* Manage application logging, monitoring, and alerting using **Azure/AWS Monitor**, **Grafana**, **Prometheus**, or ELK.
* Collaborate with development and QA teams to streamline releases and promote DevOps best practices.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and improve system reliability (SRE mindset).
* Ensure security compliance by handling **IAM**, RBAC, secrets management, network security groups, and vulnerability remediation.
* Scan pipelines for CVEs and enforce security checks.
* Configure alerting/notifications for pipeline failures and security findings.

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience with **Microsoft Azure/AWS** services.
* Solid understanding of **CI/CD**, branching strategies, and automated testing workflows.
* Experience with **Kubernetes**, **Docker**, and container-based deployments.
* Strong skills in **Terraform**, **Bash/PowerShell**, and YAML-based configurations.
* Experience working with **Linux/Windows servers** in cloud environments.
* Knowledge of monitoring, logging, and distributed system performance tuning.
* Understanding of **DevOps culture**, release automation, and cloud-native development.
* Familiarity with Helm and ArgoCD.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,800,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Junior DevOps Engineer
description:
**Job Description – Junior DevOps Engineer**
============================================

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for a motivated Junior DevOps Engineer to support cloud infrastructure management, CI/CD automation, application deployments, monitoring, and troubleshooting across Microsoft Azure and AWS environments. The candidate will work closely with senior DevOps engineers, developers, and QA teams to improve deployment efficiency, reliability, and security.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Assist in provisioning, configuring, and maintaining cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure and AWS.
* Create, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Support application builds and deployments across development, QA, UAT, and production environments.
* Manage source code repositories, branching strategies, and pull requests using Git and GitHub.
* Assist in deploying and managing containerized applications using Docker.
* Monitor cloud resources, application performance, logs, and alerts.
* Troubleshoot deployment failures, infrastructure issues, and connectivity problems.
* Follow security best practices for access management, secrets, and cloud resource configurations.
* Maintain infrastructure documentation, deployment procedures, and operational checklists.
* Collaborate with development and QA teams to resolve deployment-related issues.
* Follow change management, backup, and release management procedures.

**Must-Have Skills**
--------------------

* Basic understanding of cloud computing concepts and familiarity with Microsoft Azure and AWS.
* Knowledge of fundamental cloud services, such as Azure App Service, Storage Accounts, and Virtual Machines, and AWS EC2, S3, and IAM.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Working knowledge of Git and GitHub.
* Basic Linux commands and operating system fundamentals.
* Understanding of networking concepts, including DNS, IP addresses, ports, HTTP/HTTPS, and firewalls.
* Basic knowledge of YAML and Bash or PowerShell scripting.
* Fundamental understanding of Docker and containerization.
* Basic troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication, teamwork, and willingness to learn.

**Good-to-Have Skills**
-----------------------

* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
* Basic Kubernetes knowledge.
* Azure Key Vault, RBAC, and Managed Identity.
* AWS IAM, VPC, Security Groups, and Secrets Manager.
* Monitoring and logging using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Amazon CloudWatch, and CloudTrail.
* AWS ECR, ECS, or EKS fundamentals.
* AWS CodeBuild, CodePipeline, or other CI/CD services.
* SonarCloud or SonarQube for code quality analysis.
* Basic Python scripting and automation.
* Cloud security, backup, disaster recovery, and cost optimization fundamentals.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, and Agile methodologies.

**Educational Qualifications**
------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant internships, training, academic projects, or hands-on cloud deployment experience are preferred.
* Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) or AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner certification is an advantage but not mandatory.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**
-------------------------------

* 0–2 years of experience in DevOps, cloud computing, system administration, or a related technical role.
* Practical exposure to at least one cloud platform, with a willingness to learn the other.
* Understanding of CI/CD, source control, automation, and deployment workflows.
* Ability to troubleshoot basic technical issues and document solutions.
* Proactive attitude, continuous learning mindset, and effective communication skills.

**Key Expectations**
--------------------

* Complete assigned DevOps tasks within agreed timelines.
* Follow established deployment, security, and change management procedures.
* Maintain accurate documentation of infrastructure and deployment activities.
* Communicate task progress, blockers, and technical issues to the team.
* Continuously improve skills in Azure, AWS, CI/CD, containers, and automation.

**Important:** Candidates are not expected to have advanced expertise in both Azure and AWS. Strong fundamentals and practical experience in at least one cloud platform are essential; knowledge of the other platform can be developed on the job.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
company: Jay Maharaj Software Consulting Pvt Ltd
description:
DevOps Engineer

JMSC POS (Jay Maharaj Software Consulting Pvt Ltd.)

About Us

JMSC POS is a point-of-sale and inventory management platform serving 800–1,000 convenience stores, liquor stores, grocery stores, tobacco shops, and gas stations across the United States. Our infrastructure runs entirely on AWS and is managed as code with Terraform. We're looking for a junior DevOps engineer to help maintain and grow that infrastructure alongside our CTO.

What You'll Do

- Help manage our infrastructure as code using Terraform across a multi-account AWS Organization (Dev, QA, UAT, Prod, Sandbox, and DevOps environments)

- Support and maintain containerized services running on ECS Fargate, including deployments, scaling, and troubleshooting

- Assist with RDS (MySQL) administration — parameter groups, backups, monitoring, and secret rotation via Secrets Manager

- Help manage VPC networking: subnets, security groups, NAT gateways, load balancers, and routing

- Monitor infrastructure health with CloudWatch (alarms, logs, dashboards)

- Assist with CI/CD pipelines, ECR image management, and deployment workflows

- Write, review, and refactor Terraform modules; help keep our IaC clean and consistent

- Document infrastructure and processes

Required Qualifications

- 3–5 years of hands-on experience with AWS (internships and personal projects count)

- Working knowledge of Terraform — able to read, modify, and write modules

- Familiarity with core AWS services: RDS, ECS, VPC, and networking fundamentals (subnets, security groups, load balancers)

- Comfortable on the command line and with Git

- Understanding of containers (Docker) and basic CI/CD concepts

- Willingness to learn and take direction, with strong attention to detail

Nice to Have

- Experience with multi-account AWS Organizations

- Exposure to Fargate, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, or ECR

- Basic scripting (Python or Bash)

- AWS certification (Cloud Practitioner or Solutions Architect Associate)

Why Join Us

You'll work directly with our CTO on real production infrastructure serving hundreds of merchants nationwide, gaining broad, hands-on experience across the full AWS and Terraform stack.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a motivated DevOps Engineer with 1 to 2 years of hands-on experience in containerization, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, automation, and production support. The candidate will help build and maintain reliable deployment pipelines, manage infrastructure as code, support databases and application services, and strengthen security, backup, and disaster recovery practices.

**Key ResponsibilitiesCI/CD, Automation & Application Deployment**

* Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins for automated build, test, and deployment workflows.
* Build and manage Docker images and containers; support containerized application deployments and troubleshooting.
* Work with developers to deploy and operate Node.js applications across development, staging, and production environments.
* Write and maintain Bash scripts to automate routine operations, deployments, health checks, and log-management tasks.

**Cloud & Infrastructure Management**

* Provision, configure, and maintain infrastructure on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), including compute instances, virtual cloud networks (VCNs), storage, access controls, and related cloud services.
* Use Terraform to define, provision, and manage infrastructure as code; maintain reusable configurations and track changes safely.
* Monitor application and infrastructure availability, resource utilization, logs, and performance; investigate incidents and support root-cause analysis.
* Maintain environment configuration and deployment documentation, and follow controlled change and rollback procedures.

**Databases, Messaging & Caching**

* Support the setup, configuration, monitoring, backup, restore, and troubleshooting of PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB.
* Support Redis for caching and related operational tasks, and Kafka for messaging/broker health and basic troubleshooting.
* Coordinate with development teams on database connectivity, performance, capacity, access permissions, and service availability.
* Help verify backup completion and participate in restore testing; follow approved procedures for database changes.

**Security, Reliability & Disaster Recovery**

* Apply infrastructure security best practices, including least-privilege access, secrets handling, secure configurations, and timely patching.
* Support access management, firewall/network rules, vulnerability remediation, and secure handling of credentials and configuration files.
* Assist in setting up and maintaining backup and disaster recovery (DR) procedures, recovery documentation, and periodic DR/restore tests.
* Monitor service alerts, respond to incidents, escalate risks promptly, and participate in on-call or scheduled production support as required.

**Required Technical Skills**

* **Containers:** Docker images, containers, registries, volumes, networks, and basic troubleshooting.
* **Cloud: Hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), including compute, networking, IAM, storage, and monitoring fundamentals.**
* **CI/CD & IaC:** Jenkins pipeline fundamentals and Terraform for infrastructure provisioning.
* **Databases & Services:** Operational familiarity with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, Kafka, and Node.js application deployments.
* **Scripting:** Bash scripting for automation and routine system administration.
* **Security & DR:** Basic server hardening, access management, patching, backup/restore, monitoring, and disaster recovery concepts.
* **Operating Systems & Networking:** Linux administration, command-line troubleshooting, DNS, TCP/IP, ports, and basic networking.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree, diploma, or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 1 to 2 years of relevant experience in DevOps, cloud/infrastructure operations, deployment automation, or system administration.
* Candidates should be comfortable learning new tools, working with developers, and following documented operational procedures.
* Cloud, Linux, Docker, Jenkins, or Terraform certifications are a plus, but are not mandatory.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Reliability and success rate of CI/CD pipelines and deployments.
* Timely resolution or escalation of infrastructure and deployment incidents.
* Availability and health monitoring of applications, databases, and cloud resources.
* Completion of scheduled backups and participation in successful restore/DR tests.
* Infrastructure changes documented and managed through approved automation and change-control processes.

**Note:** The role is intended for an early-career engineer. Practical hands-on knowledge of the listed technologies is preferred. Experience supporting workloads hosted on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is required.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
